subject: How do I report my lost card?
issue: I cannot find my Visa card and I am worried it might have been stolen. What steps should I take?
response: To report your lost Visa card, you can call the 24/7 number on the back of your card or your issuer's main customer service line. In the US, you can also call Visa's global emergency number at 1-800-847-2911. Alternatively, you can report your card lost or stolen through your card issuer's mobile app or online banking. Once reported, your card will be immediately blocked, and a replacement card will be mailed to you. You are also protected by Visa's Zero Liability Policy, which means you are not responsible for unauthorized transactions reported promptly.
justification: The ticket asks about reporting a lost Visa card, and the cited chunks provide steps for reporting a lost or stolen card, including phone numbers and methods for reporting through mobile apps and online banking. The chunks also explain the Zero Liability Policy and what happens after reporting a lost card.

subject: Can I use my Visa card in Europe?

response: You can use your Visa card in Europe as Visa is accepted in over 200 countries and territories. Look for the Visa logo at checkout. However, be aware that many cards charge a foreign transaction fee of 1%–3% of the purchase amount when used outside your home country. Check your cardholder agreement for specific details. It's also recommended to notify your bank before travel to avoid any temporary blocks on unusual activity. When paying abroad, choose to pay in the local currency to get Visa's standard exchange rate.

subject: My IDE is frozen during the test

response: If the IDE has frozen during your test, do not close the tab as this may consume one of your remaining attempt slots. Instead, wait 30 seconds for the IDE to recover. If it is still frozen, try a hard-refresh of the page using Ctrl+Shift+R or Cmd+Shift+R, which will preserve your saved code. If you lose progress, you will need to contact the recruiting company to explain the situation.
